content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend oversized coat in charcoal gray (#36454F), relaxed fit with dropped shoulders and a long hemline reaching mid-thigh, fabric is heavy felted wool for warmth against snow. Silk-blend structured blouse in ivory (#FFFFF0), tailored cut with a crisp collar and a straight boxy silhouette, length hits at the high hip to layer comfortably under the coat. Wide-leg wool trousers in heather charcoal (#606A6E), cropped just above the ankle to avoid bulk over boots, fabric is thick brushed twill for wind resistance. Leather Chelsea boots in matte black (#0F1419), slim shaft hugging the calf with a low block heel for stability on salted sidewalks. Gold-plated geometric hoop earrings in polished brass (#FFD700) and a minimal silver chain necklace to provide the bold statement she requested without sacrificing warmth or professionalism during her twenty-minute walk in freezing, snowy conditions. This outfit works because the heavy wool layers ensure complete protection against -10 °C snow and road salt while maintaining a sleek silhouette that stands out in a sea of winter coats. The cropped trouser length prevents fabric from dragging on icy surfaces, offering practical safety without compromising her desire to make a fashion statement. Finally, the touch of metallic jewelry adds the requested confidence and individuality suitable for a creative workplace environment on a cold morning."}
